params.body:
## What

The panel on the bidding detail ("Biedingsaanbod / Doe een bod") now says how long the bidding still runs, in the same words, languages and tones as the card in the bidding offer.

| State | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Running | Loopt tot 07/10/2026 (grey, clock) | **Nog 6 dagen** (brand blue, medium weight) tot en met 07/10/2026 (grey) |
| End day | Loopt tot 01/10/2026 | **Laatste dag** (amber) tot middernacht |
| Ended | Afgelopen op 30/09/2026 | Afgelopen op 30/09/2026 (grey, no colour) |

## Why

The old line gave only the end date, so the reader had to count the days, while the card one click earlier already said the answer. Two wordings for one fact also meant two places to keep in step.

## How

- New partial `export/_deadline.blade.php` renders `ExportVehicle::offerDeadline()`. The card in the offer and the detail panel both include it, so there is one computation, one set of translation keys (`ui.bidding_*`, nl/fr/en/de) and one set of tones. The card's markup is unchanged.
- On the detail the date stands beside the time left (`inline`) and drops under it when the line is too narrow. At 390 px it fits on one line in all three states.
- The clock icon is gone, as on the card. Nothing dark: brand blue at weight 500, amber only on the end day, grey once ended.
- `bidding.runs_until` and `bidding.ended_on` had no other use and are removed in the four languages.
- R B1-2.11 describes the line; R B1-2.9 names the shared partial.

## Tests

- `TheBiddingDetailSaysHowLongIsLeftTest` (`@rule B1-2.11`): the detail renders what `offerDeadline()` answers for a running bidding, the end day and an ended one, with the tones, and in nl, fr, en and de.
- `TheBiddingCardReadsAtAGlanceTest` still passes unchanged against the shared partial.
- `FrenchTranslationsTest` expects the new French line on the detail.
- Full suite: 2659 tests green locally. PHPStan: no errors.

## Not in this change

A bidding with a starting price ("Bieden vanaf € ...") shows no deadline in this panel today and still does not; the same include would add it there.
params.title: The bidding detail says how long is left, in the words of the card
